properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Committed libp2p/discv5 node identity keys for the 'perfect peerdas' deterministic devnet (main.star:440-474 uploads one per client). Same 16-key set also committed as prysm/teku raw hex, lighthouse/grandine raw binary, and nimbus scrypt/AES-128-CTR keystores. Deliberately committed for reproducible testnets, so changeable in-repo; the keys are quantum-vulnerable curve material sitting in plaintext in a public repo.

components.name: CTR/CFB/OFB mode

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The encryption layer of the same nimbus netkey keystores (consumed by nimbus_launcher.star:214-219 via --netkey-file). AES-128-CTR is the standard EIP-2335/keystore cipher choice; unauthenticated by design with the checksum section carrying the MAC.

components.name: self-signed certificate

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Live first-party shell script: `openssl req -x509 -nodes -days 3650 -newkey rsa:2048 -config openssl.cnf` creates the RSA-2048 self-signed TLS certificate (10-year validity, basicConstraints CA:TRUE, SANs localhost/10.0.0.6 per the sibling openssl.cnf) used for the validator keymanager API (the docs link is Teku's external-signer keymanager guide). Changeable here. Quantum-vulnerable via Shor (RSA-2048); the private key is piped into validator_keystore.p12, whose export password is the hardcoded

components.name: AES-128

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Key-encryption layer of the nimbus peerdas keystores; AES-128 gives a Grover-halved 64-bit quantum margin — acceptable, but below CNSA 2.0's AES-256 requirement. Not urgent for a devnet.

components.name: scrypt

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: KDF protecting the nimbus node-key keystores. Parameters are strong, but the password is empty (nimbus runs with --insecure-netkey-password=true, nimbus_launcher.star:219) and the plaintext keys sit in lodestar/prysm/teku/lighthouse/grandine files in the same repo — the KDF strength is moot.

components.name: Key material (256-bit, algorithm undeclared)

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Raw 32-byte hex secp256k1 libp2p node identity keys in plaintext (prysm + teku dirs), consumed by main.star:458-461. Byte-identical to the lodestar/lighthouse/grandine/nimbus copies of the same key set — deliberately committed for the deterministic peerdas devnet, but it is plaintext hardcoded key material in a public repo.

components.name: PKCS#12 keystore

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: First half of the same pipeline as ALG-a6cca713: the x509/RSA-2048 output is piped into `openssl pkcs12 -export -out validator_keystore.p12 -passout file:keymanager.txt`, wrapping the TLS keypair in a password-protected PKCS#12 store. The export password is hardcoded in the repo (static_files/keymanager/keymanager.txt — reported as its own finding). PBES2 parameters depend on the operator's host OpenSSL (3.x default AES-256-CBC + PBKDF2; 1.x legacy 3DES/RC2). Changeable here.

components.name: PKCS#12 pfx (keystore)

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The committed binary PKCS#12 store produced by generate_certs.sh (same directory): contains the RSA-2048 self-signed keymanager-API TLS keypair, encrypted with the password hardcoded in static_files/keymanager/keymanager.txt next to it. Changeable here — regenerate and stop committing the keystore and its password.
